articles.title: Cloud keys leaked in Docker Hub images are stolen within seconds
articles.summary:
Credentials and access secrets exposed in public Docker Hub images are being extracted and exploited by attackers within as little as eight seconds of publication.
Two researchers at Stony Brook University, Billy Tsouvalas and Nick Nikiforakis, measured the extraction speed by publishing a total of 300 honeypot images across eight public container registries.
Over a period of four months, the researchers exposed AWS, OpenAI, and Anthropic API keys, along with decoy SSH and database credentials.
They then monitored the use of these keys and placed detection tools to notify them when the images were built, ran, or had a shell opened.
The two researchers presented the experiment and the resulting findings yesterday at the ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS).
They noted that their images were pulled more than 75,000 times, and the planted AWS keys received over 140,000 API calls from 5,000 unique IP addresses.
The AWS traffic showed a broad pattern, from checking whether the keys worked to listing available resources, and sometimes proceeding to consume them.
The fastest observed use of a planted AWS key came 7.86 seconds after the image was published on Docker Hub. The median time for the first API call was 51.19 seconds, while all 100 AWS keys were used within 15 minutes.
The exposed OpenAI and Anthropic keys were quickly hijacked to exhaust the test-account balances.

The core count offers the first clue to what Nvidia is building. The current Rubin GPU has 224 streaming multiprocessors and 28,672 CUDA cores, so getting past 50,000 would take at least 74% more cores.
That suggests Rubin HPC may spread its cores across several dies in one package, as the two-die Rubin does, or as the four-die Rubin Ultra that Nvidia originally planned, a design since reportedly scaled back. Nvidia has not confirmed the chip's physical layout and describes the core count only as being "on a single GPU." The image it released with the announcement does not appear to show a multi-die design.
Nvidia's pitch is less about raw compute and more about keeping that compute busy. The company says climate modeling, engineering simulation, genomic analysis and financial risk work tend to follow the same pattern: a program reaches into a huge dataset, pulls out a few scattered values, runs a calculation and then repeats that step an enormous number of times. La nouvelle Apple TV serait-elle pas assez performante ? La puce A19 n'est pas strictement identique à celle que l'on trouve dans les iPhone 17.
La nouvelle Apple TV 2026 cache un secret qu'Apple s'est bien gardé d'annoncer quand elle a été dévoilée. En effet, selon des données de diagnostic système, il lui manquerait un cœur sur sa puce A19.
La nouvelle ère de l'immersion sonore Samsung
À l’occasion du Black Friday 2026, Samsung baisse le prix de sa meilleure barre de son.
Un cœur en moins
Des données de diagnostic partagées par l'explorateur de code pdfu indiquent que la nouvelle Apple TV 4K utiliserait une puce A19, avec un cœur efficient coupé. La puce compterait donc 5 cœurs au total, contre 6 habituellement, pour les versions commercialisées dans les iPhone sortis l'an passé, notamment l'iPhone 17.
Les fréquences maximales relevées sont de 4,26 GHz pour les cœurs performants et de 2,592 GHz pour les cœurs efficients. Le GPU, doté de cinq cœurs, atteindrait quant à lui 1,47 GHz. Il s'agit de fréquences maximales et non de mesures de performances.
Pourquoi une puce moins performante ?
À l'instar des MacBook Neo, Apple ferait en fait du recyclage avec cette puce. Si les MacBook Neo utilisent une puce A18 Pro défectueuse, avec un cœur qui ne fonctionne pas correctement, la marque à la pomme reproduit l'opération ici. Le cœur désactivé serait en fait défectueux, et le fabricant préfère le couper, afin de proposer des performances correctes, pour des produits qui n'ont pas be…

articles.title: Critical Java4Shell flaw allows RCE attacks on major Java applications
articles.summary:
A critical vulnerability dubbed Java4Shell in OpenJDK, the open-source implementation of Java, can allow unauthenticated attackers to remotely execute code on popular enterprise applications, including Jenkins, Atlassian Jira, Confluence, and Keycloak.
Java is one of the most widely used programming platforms in the world, powering enterprise applications, web services, financial systems, and critical business infrastructure.
Because many applications use the same Java runtime, vulnerabilities in its core components can affect a wide range of different and unrelated applications.
The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-114938, is a memory-corruption flaw in Java's hardware-accelerated Base64 decoding functionality that can be exploited to disclose sensitive information from memory or achieve remote code execution (RCE).
Security researchers at Calif, who disclosed the flaw on Tuesday, rated it critical with a CVSS 4.0 score of 9.2, while Oracle assigned it a lower severity rating of 8.1 (High) using CVSS 3.1.
Java4Shell affects OpenJDK 17.0.6 and later, as well as Java distributions built from the affected code, including Oracle Java SE, Amazon Corretto, Eclipse Temurin, Microsoft Build of OpenJDK, Azul Zulu, and Red Hat OpenJDK.
The vulnerability stems from a bug in Java's Base64 decoder, which processes encoded data commonly found in authentication, file uploads, and network communications.

articles.title: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
The Securities and Exchange Commission is opening a civil probe into Nvidia over whether the company’s disclosures misled investors, according to The Wall Street Journal.
The investigation adds to Nvidia’s stack of drama after CEO Jensen Huang resigned following news of his extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy, Alice Huang, an executive at Singapore-based data company Megaspeed.
The Commerce Department has been investigating Megaspeed since late 2024 under suspicion that the company diverted some of its Nvidia chips to China, which would violate U.S. export laws.
Congress has also demanded that Huang answer questions about his affair and how it might have affected his stance that export restrictions should be loosened. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent put it more bluntly over the weekend, accusing Nvidia of knowingly selling powerful chips to China to “goose their revenues and their earnings.”
The news of the SEC probe also comes as Nvidia reports earnings to a market that has seen its stock fall more than 10% since Huang departed. The chipmaker reported revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year ago.

From the source: “We are leading the way in Canada when it comes to growing the economy in the right way while protecting our environment and our way of life,” a portion of the throne speech reads. “We listened to the community and stopped an AI data centre from being built in Île-des-Chênes.”
The context: The provincial government’s outline of any potential ban was sparse, with no detail given as to how or when such a prohibition might come into effect, what it might look like, and how it could be enforced. BetaKit reached out to the Manitoba government to ask those questions but has not yet received a response.
Manitoba has taken a decidedly cautious approach to AI regulation. In addition to proposing a ban on real estate imagery, the Province was also the first Canadian jurisdiction to propose a ban on AI chatbot use for youth younger than 16. articles.title: La pantalla del Galaxy S27 podría cambiar para siempre el diseño de los Galaxy
articles.summary:
Samsung no ha cambiado mucho el diseño de los Galaxy en los últimos tres años. Fuera de algunos ajustes en el módulo de la cámara y esquinas más redondeadas, la serie Galaxy S mantiene el mismo lenguaje visual desde 2023. Esto podría acabar con el Galaxy S27, ya que Samsung prepara uno de los cambios estéticos más ambiciosos al desarrollar un móvil con pantalla sin bordes.
De acuerdo con SamMobile, Samsung desarrolla una nueva tecnología de pantalla capaz de reducir al mínimo los marcos del dispositivo. Una filtración en Naver Blog afirma que la división móvil de la compañía explora posibles diseños para un Galaxy sin bordes. Aunque todavía no hay detalles sobre la tecnología, Samsung podría volver a un concepto similar al que vimos hace una década con el Galaxy Edge.
Si hacemos memoria, el Galaxy S6 Edge debutó en 2015 con una pantalla curva en ambos lados. Aunque el diseño era interesante, este formato tomó más fuerza un año más tarde con el Galaxy S7 Edge, que se convirtió en uno de los móviles más exitosos de la época. Su pantalla se extendía hacia los laterales, eliminando los marcos y aprovechando todo el espacio.
Es probable que Samsung explore nuevamente este concepto, aunque ahora con una pantalla curvada en los cuatro lados. La compañía quiere ser la primera en estrenar esta innovación, por lo que ha posado el acelerador para lanzarla antes que el iPhone. articles.title: U.S. Cracks Down on China Renting AI GPUs Through Overseas Data Centers
articles.summary:
Tuesday, November 17th 2026
U.S. Cracks Down on China Renting AI GPUs Through Overseas Data Centers
Yesterday, the U.S. Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) released an interim final rule to address remote access to advanced AI chips and servers. This rule significantly addresses a long-standing gap in U.S. export controls, where Chinese companies that are barred from accessing NVIDIA's latest GPUs have been renting overseas computing power instead of purchasing the chips outright. Notably, BIS states that the rule was written by and at the direction of the Department of the Treasury and the National Security Council.
Under the new rule, a license is required to ship any advanced accelerators to any data center worldwide that provides more than 12 million "aggregate TPP" of computing power to companies headquartered in Macau or Country Group D:5, which includes China. TPP, or Total Processing Performance, is BIS's metric for chip computing power, calculated as a chip's peak dense throughput multiplied by the bit length of the operation. For example, an H100 rates about 15,800 TPP. "Aggregate TPP" sums up every accelerator in the facility, so the cap equates to roughly 750 H100s or around 330 B200s. The limit also applies to "linked data centers" and indirect access, such as a cloud reseller training models for a Chinese firm. Data centers already serving such customers have 90 days to obtain a license. Only "commercial recommender systems" are exempt, a…

Mercedes-Benz anunció que ofrecerá en Alemania y Estados Unidos un asistente de conducción que guía el auto desde el punto de partida hasta el destino, incluso en el tránsito denso de la ciudad. El sistema, llamado MB.DRIVE ASSIST PRO, llegará en 2027 y exige que el conductor mantenga la atención y las manos en el volante.
La empresa lo presentó el 16 de noviembre junto con otra función: el asistente de autopista que permite soltar el volante. Ambos son sistemas de nivel 2, según la escala de la industria. Eso significa que el conductor sigue siendo el responsable de la conducción y debe estar listo para tomar el control en cualquier momento.
Una vez que se carga un destino en el navegador, el sistema se activa con un botón del volante. Según la compañía, puede salir de la autopista, cambiar de carril, incorporarse al carril correcto, doblar en las intersecciones y frenar o arrancar en los semáforos.
Para eso usa 27 componentes de detección: 10 cámaras, cinco radares y 12 sensores de ultrasonido. Una computadora procesa los datos con una capacidad de hasta 254 TOPS, una medida de operaciones por segundo. El sistema combina el software de la marca con tecnología de Nvidia, según informó la empresa en octubre.

articles.title: Alfonso, funcionario de la Seguridad Social: “Quien retrase un año su jubilación podrá recibir un pago de 8.500 euros”
articles.summary:
Explica Alfonso Muñoz Cuenca que uno de los incentivos que tienen los trabajadores que deciden continuar trabajando tras alcanzar su edad ordinaria de retiro es el de poder acceder a un pago único de 8.000 o 8.500 euros. Es decir, se trata de un incentivo que puede pagarse si se retrasa un año la jubilación. Depende de la situación de cada trabajador.
Con la jubilación demorada, el trabajador puede optar por retrasar de manera voluntaria su acceso a la pensión a cambio de un complemento económico. Este complemento puede ser en forma de incremento de la pensión mensual o bien a tanto alzado. También puede haber una mezcla de ambos. En este caso sí que hace falta que se haya retrasado un mínimo de dos años completos. Es decir, que si solo se retrasa un año, no se puede pedir la opción de pago mixto.
Este pago se calcula de manera individual. Depende de la cantidad de la pensión y de los años cotizados que tenga el trabajador en el momento de alcanzar la edad ordinaria de jubilación. Por ello, en algunos casos, los 8.500 euros de los que habla Muñoz pueden ser superiores. De hecho, en algunos casos pueden llegar a ser superiores a los 10.000 euros por año de demora. En los ejemplos que pone el organismo ya se contempla esta posibilidad. Es el caso de las personas que tienen una carrera de cotización más larga y una pensión más alta.

articles.title: Ticketmaster, NHL lobby Alberta over ticket reselling bill
articles.summary:
The provincial government of Alberta is considering new measures to address high ticket resale prices, as new regulations are being debated in the provincial legislature. However, the National Hockey League (NHL) and its ticket partner, Ticketmaster, are lobbying officials to ensure the proposed consumer protection laws don’t conflict with business interests.
Dave Nally, the minister of Service Alberta and Red Tape Reduction, introduced a new piece of legislation, Bill 34, on Oct. 28 that would require all ticket resellers to disclose all associated prices and fees.
This new bill doesn’t include a price cap on resale tickets, but one could come into effect later. The government added that the legislation opens the door to additional protections, which will be determined through future consultations. Alongside this, members of the official opposition criticized the legislation’s lack of concrete price caps during a Nov. 3 debate in the legislature.
According to Alberta’s lobbyist registry, the NHL registered to lobby the provincial government on Nov. 2. on consumer protection and resale tickets to “ensure the interests of the NHL (e.g., World Cup of Hockey 2028, Calgary Flames, Edmonton Oilers) are not negatively impacted.”

IBM Corp. subsidiary Red Hat and Microsoft Corp. are expanding their longtime engineering partnership to enable enterprises to run virtual machines on Microsoft Azure using Red Hat’s OpenShift Virtualization platform, providing an alternative to traditional hypervisors and what Red Hat called a path to modernizing legacy applications.
The collaboration, announced today, involves changes to Azure’s underlying computing architecture to connect it natively with Linux through Microsoft direct virtualization. That’s an Azure feature that gives performance-sensitive workloads near-bare-metal access to underlying hardware components.
Red Hat said this provides a direct pipeline between key hardware such as graphics processing units and isolated workloads. The companies are also working to give Linux-based workloads more direct access to Azure’s hardware resources, including graphics processing units.

articles.title: Announcing AI data preparation capabilities in Amazon SageMaker: Build high-quality datasets for model development workflows | Amazon Web Services

Artificial Intelligence
Announcing AI data preparation capabilities in Amazon SageMaker: Build high-quality datasets for model development workflows
Teams that ship generative AI to production know that a model is only as good as its data. That is why preparing high-quality training and evaluation data comes first. Fine-tuning an open-weight model, running reinforcement learning, or building an evaluation suite all depend on data that is accurate, well-labeled, and representative of your task. For narrow, well-defined tasks, a smaller model customized on clean, task-specific data can often match or exceed the accuracy of a larger general-purpose model prompted into shape, at a lower cost per inference.
In practice, though, preparing that data is often the slowest part of the project. Labeled examples are scarce or expensive, and privacy rules limit what you can use. Quality problems such as duplicates, label noise, and answer leakage go unnoticed until a training run disappoints, and every training technique expects data in its own format. As a result, data scientists spend weeks wrangling data instead of building models.
Today, we’re expanding Amazon SageMaker AI with new AI data preparation capabilities for model development workflows. You can generate synthetic examples, assess and improve existing datasets, and bring expert feedback into the process through Python SDK APIs and the AWS AI-ML agent skill. articles.title: The iPhone Duo can now unlock with your face, no Face ID required
articles.summary:
In a nutshell: Most iPhone owners haven't touched a fingerprint reader in years, so when the iPhone Duo arrived with Touch ID in its side button instead of Face ID, the change quickly became one of the foldable's most common complaints. Apple's fix doesn't involve any new hardware, though. The second developer beta of iOS 27.3, released Monday, lets the Duo recognize your face using the ordinary front camera on its outer screen.
The new option shows up as Unlock with Front Camera under Touch ID & Passcode in Settings. It only works while the phone is folded shut, though. Opening the Duo still means reaching for the fingerprint reader it launched with, or typing in a passcode.
Apple's own setup screen is surprisingly blunt about the trade-off, warning that the feature "isn't as secure as Touch ID or Face ID." That's likely because an ordinary selfie camera only sees a flat picture of you. Face ID, on the other hand, maps your face in 3D using more than 30,000 infrared dots.
As a result, the feature only gets you past the lock screen. Apple Pay, saved passwords and app sign-ins all still need a fingerprint. Even then, it won't kick in unless you've recently unlocked with Touch ID or a passcode. Leave the phone untouched for roughly 45 minutes, and it's back to the side button.

Arrêté et condamné depuis, il est repassé devant la justice pénale et pour la première fois, il a reconnu les faits.

Privé d’ordinateur, Arion Kurtaj a utilisé un Amazon Fire Stick à l’arrière de la télévision de sa chambre, un clavier et une souris et a piraté Rockstar Games. Avec ce hack, il a récupéré 90 séquences de gameplay de GTA VI, accède au canal de communication interne de l’entreprise et menace de publier le code s’il n’est pas contacté. articles.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
Anthropic on Tuesday disclosed more details about the biggest investment agreements with major cloud providers Amazon and Google.
While we already knew that Amazon stood to make a killing on its Anthropic investments from the IPO, Anthropic revealed that Amazon’s total stake will come in at just shy of 15% (14.7% to be exact).
Even more interesting is that Amazon could have, if it wished, owned an even bigger share of the company. When Amazon invested billions in Anthropic in 2023 and 2024 (long before Claude Code took the enterprise world by storm, back in the days when Anthropic looked like it would forever be a speck in OpenAI’s shadow), the cloud giant obtained promissory notes that could convert into equity.
These notes carry conversion prices of about $2.09 or $5.05 per share, depending on the year of investment. US prosecutors charged 24-year-old British man Tyler Robert Buchanan and four other suspects in November with wire fraud and aggravated identity theft in relation to a series of phishing attacks between September 2021 and April 2023.
According to court documents, their victims include companies across a wide range of industries, such as telecommunications, technology, business process outsourcing (BPO), entertainment, and information technology (IT) suppliers, as well as virtual currency providers, cloud communications providers, and individuals.
Buchanan and his accomplices sent hundreds of SMS phishing messages to victim companies' employees' phones (while impersonating the companies or a contracted IT or BPO supplier) to trick them into entering sensitive information (including credentials and personally identifiable information) into phishing pages that looked like their employers' legitimate websites.
The stolen information was used to steal over $11.6 million of virtual currency after compromising victims' cryptocurrency accounts and wallets via Subscriber Identity Module (SIM) swaps (also known as SIM swapping attacks).

Debemos tener en cuenta la duración del contrato y el estado registral. En función de estos, puede haber que respetar el alquiler hasta cierto momento y puede ser necesario que el vendedor indemnice.
Esto viene regulado en el artículo 14 de la LAU. También existe la posibilidad de que haya que indemnizar. Esto sucede cuando el contrato es de más de 5 (o 7) años y el comprador cumple con ciertos requisitos.
Comprador debe respetar el alquiler
Los 5 primeros años (o 7 si el anterior arrendador era una persona jurídica, como por ejemplo una empresa), el nuevo dueño es sustituto del anterior arrendador. No podemos desahuciar al inquilino ni modificar unilateralmente lo que se ha firmado por el hecho de comprar el piso.
Deben contarse a partir de la fecha de inicio del contrato. Es decir que debemos respetar el tiempo que falta para llegar a los 5 (o 7) años.
En el caso de que se haya pactado un plazo mayor, la norma general es que el comprador también se vea afectado por todo el plazo. Hay una excepción en la que sí hay que indemnizar. Four years ago, Arion Kurtaj hacked into Rockstar Games using an Amazon Fire Stick, a hotel television, and a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse, stealing footage of the unreleased Grand Theft Auto 6. This week, the 21-year-old from Oxford pleaded guilty at Woolwich Crown Court to the breach, as well as several other cyber attacks he carried out at the ages of 16 and 17 as a member of the hacking group Lapsus$.
The plea follows an unusual legal process: Kurtaj was initially committed to a secure hospital but was later deemed fit to stand trial.
When he targeted Rockstar, Kurtaj was already on bail for other hacking offences. Police had seized his computer and placed him in a Travelodge in Bicester. The move was intended to protect him from rival hackers who had threatened to attack him over his stolen Bitcoin.
The hotel room did little to stop him. Kurtaj plugged a Fire Stick, a consumer device used to stream video, into the room's television. He then connected a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse and used the setup to access Rockstar's internal systems.
He stole internal company data, including 90 clips showing nearly an hour of gameplay from the unfinished title. He also accessed Rockstar's internal Slack messaging system and posted a demand: "If Rockstar does not contact me on Telegram within 24 hours I will start releasing the source code."

Artificial Intelligence

Enterprises today need a clear way to extend their authentication and authorization controls into the agentic layer, often requiring either broad service account permissions or custom-built auth integrations that add operational overhead. When an AI agent running on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (a platform to build, connect, and optimize agents at scale, with any framework or model) needs to call the Snowflake-managed MCP server (which exposes Snowflake Cortex Agents as one of its tool types) through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the first question enterprises must answer is: how does the agent authenticate? In this post, we walk through three Open Authorization (OAuth) configurations we tested on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity, a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: Snowflake OAuth (per-user, no external Identity Provider, or IdP), three-legged OAuth with a third-party Identity Provider (corporate single sign-on, or SSO), and two-legged OAuth with a third-party Identity Provider (shared service user). Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity also supports an on-behalf-of (OBO) grant (TOKEN_EXCHANGE) that delivers per-user identity for unattended workloads without a consent prompt. We focus on the three configurations we tested end-to-end, flagging where OBO fits as we go. By the end, you will be able to identify which pattern suits your enterprise scenario.

articles.title: La ciencia quiere jubilar el IMC como medida de la obesidad. Pero sustituirlo por una cinta métrica tampoco es tan sencillo
articles.summary:
Durante mucho tiempo, para determinar si una persona tenía obesidad o no, se ha usado el cálculo del IMC, dividiendo el peso en kilos por el cuadrado de la altura en metros. Sin embargo, son muchas las voces que han ido surgiendo en contra de ceñirse únicamente a esta medida, apostando más por el perímetro de la cintura o por un conjunto de datos interrelacionados.
Viene de lejos. La recomendación no es una ocurrencia divulgativa, sino el reflejo directo de un macroestudio publicado en la revista Nature. Un trabajo que supone un nuevo paradigma para redefinir la obesidad, puesto que, tras analizar datos de 844.108 adultos, se ha visto qué ocurre cuando se cruza el clásico índice de masa corporal con el perímetro de la cintura y el índice cintura-talla.
El resultado confirma que el IMC, utilizado en solitario, sobrestimaba la obesidad en entre un 1,2 % y un 3,1 % de los participantes, pero lo más preocupante es que deja escapar entre un 5,2 % y un 8,6 % de los casos reales de exceso de grasa.
¿Por qué pasa? El problema del IMC es matemático y anatómico, puesto que en su concepción nunca fue diseñado para evaluar el estado de salud de una persona en concreto. Y es que la fórmula es ciega a la composición corporal, ya que no distingue si un kilo extra corresponde a masa muscular, tejido óseo o grasa, ni tampoco revela dónde se almacena esa grasa.

Encryption forms the backbone of our everyday digital lives including banking transactions, healthcare and communication. However, the rise of quantum computing is challenging our assumptions about how long certain types of security will remain effective.
Imagine a scenario where confidential information that was encrypted and sent years ago is suddenly able to be decrypted. The security systems worked as intended, the information was exchanged, the encryption algorithms were considered secure and there was no evidence of a breach. However, advances in computing have made that formerly secure information vulnerable. This is a concern that is driving the discussion about quantum resistant security.
We use encryption to secure almost every aspect of our digital lives. From banking transactions and healthcare data to industrial communications and defence systems, the encryption algorithms we use to secure sensitive information have been trusted for decades. However, the rise of quantum computing is challenging our assumptions about how long certain types of security will remain effective.

Wear OS smartwatches just got a big free battery life boost — software update lets you use your Android phone’s GNSS to track workouts
Now your watch can keep going for as long as you do
- The latest Google Play Services update lets you use your phone's GNSS to track your location during Wear OS workouts
- This should save a substantial amount of battery on your smartwatch during runs and other outdoor workouts
- Of course, it means you'll have to take your phone with you
While Wear OS smartwatches generally have enough battery life to get you through a day or more, their tiny batteries can start to struggle a bit during a lengthy outdoor workout — in part because their Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) receiver needs to be active. But thanks to the latest Google Play Services update, that’s no longer the case.
As spotted by Android Authority, the latest Google Play Services version (v26.45) adds the ability for your watch to use your phone’s GNSS to track your location during outdoor workouts, thereby helping your watch to conserve its battery life.
Of course, that means you have to bring your phone on your workout with you, and it also only works if your phone isn’t on Battery Saver mode.
Draining one battery or another

articles.title: New study shows how school phone bans help with learning
articles.summary:
A new U.S. study has shown how banning cell phones from schools can improve student learning.
The findings were released by Harvard’s Center for Education Policy Research (CEPR) in partnership with researchers at NWEA and Dartmouth. According to the researchers, this is the first national analysis “comparing achievement growth for individual students, before and after strict cell phone bans.”
They say that as smartphones became widely adopted between 2013 and 2024, eighth-grade math and reading achievement fell by roughly one grade equivalent. This worked out to losing “the equivalent of two to three weeks of learning every year,” which the researchers acknowledged is “small on an annual basis” but nonetheless “accumulated” over time. Ultimately, they found that banning phones in schools worked out to restoring the equivalent of one to two weeks of lost learning each year, or about half of the annual decline in achievement since 2013.
To conduct the study, the researchers analyzed data from 3.3 million students attending 4,600 schools nationally during the 2021–22 through 2025–26 school years. Specifically, they examined schools that implemented strict cellphone bans that required students to store their devices in lockable pouches for the day.
Overall, these were some of the key findings:
- Lockable pouches had a “modest yet steady positive impact on student achievement” that lasted the four years

articles.title: Civilization studio Firaxis Games lays off a third of staff
articles.summary:
Firaxis Games, the studio behind the Civilization and XCOM franchises of computer strategy games, last week laid off about a third of its staff, totaling around 60 people. That’s according to a recent report in Bloomberg.
The report cites people “familiar with the cuts,” saying that the flagship game the studio is currently working on, a new entry in the XCOM series, “has faced development struggles and missed a significant milestone.” The departures also include the studio head, Heather Hazen.
A Firaxis spokesperson released the following statement:
Firaxis is restructuring and recentering around the studio’s core strength—designing world class strategy games that have set the industry standard for the genre for the last 30 years. As part of these changes, the size of the studio is being reduced to focus on design, technology and the player experience, which means saying goodbye to talented colleagues who helped build Firaxis. These decisions are never easy, but they’re essential to build the next chapter of Firaxis.
The storied studio has had a rough run of things of late. Its most recent game, Civilization VII, launched to solid enough sales but divided players in terms of reception. Players have long criticized new Civilization titles for being barebones compared to immediate predecessors that have seen multiple post-launch updates and expansions, but the response was sharper this time.

articles.title: Govern and discover records with common metadata in AWS Agent Registry | Amazon Web Services
articles.summary:
Artificial Intelligence
Govern and discover records with common metadata in AWS Agent Registry
As organizations build more agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and skills, they need a consistent way to describe, govern, and find them. AWS Agent Registry provides a catalog for registering, approving, and discovering these resources and custom records. Each record carries a name, a description, a protocol descriptor, and an approval status. However, every organization has attributes and facts that it wants to track, and some are unique to that organization, such as its business units, resource owners, risk classifications, and development environments. Organizations want one common definition for each of these attributes, and they want every agent, MCP server, and skill in the registry to carry these facts. Until now, organizations had no way to define these facts in AWS Agent Registry and store them on each record.
Custom metadata schemas are now available in AWS Agent Registry. A custom metadata schema is a set of organization-defined key-value pairs that records in an AWS Agent Registry carry. An administrator defines the schema and applies it to the registry, and all records within the registry must then adhere to the schema. When publishers create or submit records, they supply values for the fields specified in the applicable schema, and AWS Agent Registry validates those values against the schema set by the admin. articles.title: La Voyager 1 llegará mañana a un día luz de la Tierra: sus señales tardarán 24 horas en llegar hasta nosotros
articles.summary:
La NASA está a punto de recibir por primera vez un mensaje enviado desde un día luz de distancia. Tanto esta como otras agencias espaciales están más que familiarizadas con recibir señales mucho más lejanas que esa, gracias a los avances de la tecnología espacial. Sin embargo, será la primera vez que alguien recibe un mensaje tan lejano emitido por un objeto creado por el ser humano. Dicho objeto es la sonda Voyager 1, lanzada en 1977.
Los datos. El 18 de noviembre, 10:16 UTC (11:16, hora peninsular española), la Voyager 1 enviará señales de telemetría a los científicos de la NASA como lleva haciendo casi 50 años. Sin embargo, en esta ocasión el mensaje tardará justo 24 horas en llegar, ya que la sonda estará a 1 día luz de nuestro planeta. Esto no supone nada a nivel práctico, pero es un gran hito que está siendo muy celebrado tanto por la comunidad científica como por toda la sociedad.
Un saludo simbólico. Aunque la Voyager 1 no nos enviará ningún mensaje especial, nosotros sí podemos hacerlo. La NASA ha preparado para la ocasión una web con la que los móviles y tablets pueden parpadear simbólicamente en “VGR”, la señal de llamada de la sonda en código Morse. Esperan que muchas personas se unan a la iniciativa para que haya un anillo de luces saludando a Voyager 1 a lo largo de todo el mundo.

articles.title: Amazon SageMaker AI real-time endpoints now support KV cache aware routing | Amazon Web Services
articles.summary:
Artificial Intelligence
Amazon SageMaker AI real-time endpoints now support KV cache aware routing
Today, Amazon SageMaker AI introduces KV cache-aware routing (KV-aware routing), a new routing strategy for real-time endpoints. It uses the cache state that the model container reports. It sends each request to an instance that already holds a long cached match for its prompt and isn’t too busy. It’s for teams that serve large language models (LLMs) with multi-turn conversations, long shared prompts, or heavy load. You turn it on in two places: add one environment variable to your model so the container reports its cache contents, and set RoutingStrategy to KV_AWARE in the endpoint configuration. Your clients call the endpoint with the same APIs as before.
Here’s the problem it solves: LLM applications such as chat assistants, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and agents with long system prompts send many requests that start with the same text. A model keeps the work it did on a prompt in GPU memory, the KV cache, and skips that work when the same start reaches the same instance again. In part 1 of this series, we introduced prefix-aware routing for Amazon SageMaker AI, which sends requests that start the same way to the same instance. Prefix-aware routing infers where a prefix is cached from the request alone, so it can’t tell when an instance has evicted that cache.

Q.ANT Unveils NPU Gen 2+: Photonic Fourier Transforms Power Large Language Model

The NPU Gen 2+ adds optical Discrete Fourier Transforms (DFTs), which expands the set of mathematical functions developers can run directly in light with photonic computing. With it, developers can build faster, leaner AI models and high-performance computing (HPC) applications.
Advanced functions like the DFT let AI models work with fewer parameters and less data. On digital hardware, however, computing the transform itself with high data volumes costs time and energy. Because the NPU Gen 2+ delivers DFTs natively in light, Q.ANT demonstrates the potential algorithmic and performance advantages of photonic computing already now.Developers can now approach computationally intensive functions in new ways using the DFT capabilities of the NPU Gen 2+: Light carries out complex computations in a single pass, extending the set of available instructions beyond add and multiply functions of classical computing and making AI models more expressive and more powerful. ReportURI said it identified 178 websites—including CNN, Zoom, the BBC, and Salesforce—that were affected. JavaScript digitally signed by Optimizely and then loaded into customer pages had been modified to include malicious components that attempted to infect visitor devices with multiple payloads. When wares were installed successfully, they swapped user cryptocurrency wallet addresses for the attackers. Other components skimmed payment cards, stole cookies and screenshots, and, on iPhones and iPads, delivered iOS exploit kits known as Coruna and DarkSword.
Optimizely infrastructure delivers multipurpose malware
Optimizely serves JavaScript “snippets” that include both company code and code that is provided by each customer. The JavaScript, which can be served directly from Optimizely or from a customer endpoint, runs on every page the customer serves. Somehow, the attackers wrote their own code into a portion of each affected customer’s JavaScript and then delivered it from cdn.optimizely.com. A valid certificate for that domain signed the JavaScript.

articles.title: Cut generative AI costs: Code for rules, models for judgment | Amazon Web Services
articles.summary:
Artificial Intelligence
Cut generative AI costs: Code for rules, models for judgment
The biggest cost lever in a generative AI system is whether you call a model at all. We often see teams route every task through a large language model (LLM), including input validation, formatting, and routing. Each call is cheap in isolation, but at production scale these small costs become one of the largest line items in the architecture. Wherever a deterministic rule can do the job, skipping the model saves money, cuts latency, and removes a source of non-determinism. In this post, you learn how to decide whether each step in a workflow needs a model at all. You can then map each option to AWS: deterministic code, a constrained decision call, or a right-sized model on Amazon Bedrock.
Why unneeded model calls add up
The pattern usually starts in a prototype. A model call works for one step, so it becomes the default for the next. Those steps include validating input, reformatting a request body, and picking a route. At prototype volume, nobody notices the cost.
At production volume, unneeded model calls cost you in three ways:
- Spend grows with request count, even for low-value steps.
- Latency stacks, because every model call in a chain adds hundreds of milliseconds.
- Output can vary, because the same input can return a different answer. That makes testing harder and audits slower.
Each new model launch then restarts the debate about which model to use. The earlier question, whether th…

“Este caso se convirtió en una defensa por ChatGPT”, escribieron los fiscales, según el 404 media. Agregaron que responder a los escritos de la defensa equivale a contestar documentos generados por “un robot que intenta ejercer la abogacía” y los calificaron de “basura de IA”.
El acusado es Khalwinder Bhengura, un indio que llegó a Estados Unidos con visa de inmigrante en 2022. Se registró para votar en Texas en 2024 tras presuntamente declarar falsamente que era ciudadano al tramitar su licencia de conducir. Fue arrestado en septiembre de 2026 y declarado culpable en octubre de dos de los tres cargos.
Los fiscales ejecutaron varios escritos de la defensa por Pangram y presentaron los resultados como anexo de uno de sus argumentos. Esos resultados fueron mixtos: no indicaron que los textos fueran totalmente de IA. Aun así, los fiscales sostuvieron que no debían responder de fondo a escritos parcialmente generados con esa tecnología.

articles.title: Nvidia at SC26: Agents are the new scientists, and they need a lab - SiliconANGLE
articles.summary:
Nvidia at SC26: Agents are the new scientists, and they need a lab
For most of its history, the high-performance computing market measured progress the same way: how fast a machine could solve a fixed problem. Rankings rose, a new system took the top spot, and the cycle started over. Raw performance remains the foundation of scientific computing, and Nvidia Corp. brought plenty of it to SC26.
But this week, Nvidia argued that speed at solving a single problem is no longer the right way to measure leadership. An equally important question now is how many times a researcher can go from hypothesis to result in a day, and what happens when the “researcher” is an artificial intelligence agent that never sleeps.
That idea ties together Nvidia’s bevy of announcements at the show. The company introduced open science models, a CPU-only supercomputing rack, a new HPC-specific GPU, a batch of CUDA-X libraries, quantum integration for the Slurm workload manager, a quantum co-design platform with IBM and Fermilab, and a co-packaged optics deployment at Lambda. It also marked CUDA’s 20th birthday.
Taken individually, these announcements look like a typical supercomputing show news payload. Taken together, they describe a stack built for a different user, namely the AI agent that reasons through a scientific problem, calls a simulation, reads the result and decides what to try next.

As enterprises build production agents with dozens of tools and large structured inputs, token consumption and latency become the primary blockers to a good user experience. When these agents process large JSON data, every additional tool invocation injects the full payload into the large language model (LLM) context window, causing token usage and response latency to spike. Over multi-turn conversations, this pressure compounds, driving up costs and degrading response quality. Effectively managing context-window pressure in agentic systems is key to reliability and responsiveness at scale. An ATM running out of cash is a problem customers notice immediately. Keeping too much money inside it creates a quieter problem for the bank: Funds sit idle, while replenishment visits add costs. Across hundreds of machines, deciding how much cash to deliver, where, and when becomes a substantial optimization challenge.
Intesa Sanpaolo claimed double-digit cost reductions from a new approach, without compromising service levels. The work emerged from the Italian banking group’s quantum computing research. The calculations, however, run entirely on classical GPUs.
That apparent contradiction gets to the heart of quantum-inspired computing. Researchers can borrow ideas from quantum algorithms and find useful ways to apply them on existing hardware. Whether a quantum processor will eventually improve on those results is a separate question.
According to Davide Corbelletto, quantum specialist and team leader of Intesa Sanpaolo’s Quantum Competence Center, what changed was the approach. “It’s a shift in the way you model the problem you’re trying to solve,” he told EE Times.
A new way of looking at the problem
Intesa selected ATM cash replenishment as a proving ground because it combined business relevance with technical suitability. Its broader outsourced network exceeds 1,000 ATMs. The bank validated the optimization system using a real network comprising hundreds of machines.

articles.title: AMD Completes Acquisition of Taalas to Advance AI Inference Innovation
articles.summary:
Tuesday, November 17th 2026
AMD Completes Acquisition of Taalas to Advance AI Inference Innovation
AMD today announced the completion of its acquisition of Taalas, a pioneer in specialized AI inference silicon, further strengthening the company's full-stack AI portfolio and long-term inference roadmap. As demand for AI inference accelerates, Taalas brings differentiated technology and world-class engineering expertise designed to deliver breakthrough performance and efficiency for increasingly specialized AI workloads.
"AI inference is evolving rapidly, and customers need a broad range of compute solutions optimized for their workloads," said Vamsi Boppana, senior vice president of the Artificial Intelligence Group at AMD. "With Taalas now part of AMD, we're expanding our ability to deliver differentiated inference performance and efficiency, while strengthening our full-stack AI platform."AMD plans to integrate Taalas' technology into its accelerator roadmap and develop system-level solutions alongside AMD Instinct GPUs, complementing its broader portfolio of AMD EPYC CPUs, AMD ROCm software and the AMD Helios rackscale solution.
The acquisition also expands AMD's engineering presence in Canada and reinforces its commitment to advancing AI innovation and growing world-class technical talent.

articles.title: GTA 6 is here: everything Indian players need to know
articles.summary:
GTA 6 is here: Everything Indian players need to know
The biggest game launch in years arrives on 19 November. Here is what it costs in India, what you need to play it, and what is still unclear.
Grand Theft Auto VI goes live on Thursday, 19 November 2026, more than 13 years after GTA V. Store listings in India show a 12:00 am IST start. The game arrives on the PlayStation 5 and the Xbox Series X and S only. There is no PC version, and none for the PS4 or Xbox One.
The price in rupees
PlayStation India lists the Standard Edition at Rs 5,999 and the Ultimate Edition at Rs 7,499. Both come with the Vintage Vice City Pack and one month of GTA+, Rockstar's subscription service. The Ultimate Edition adds an upgrade pack, and buyers of the Standard Edition can reportedly move up later for Rs 1,500, so there is no need to decide in a hurry.
For anyone who already owns a console, that is the whole bill. For everyone else, the game is the small part of the cost. Amazon India listed the PS5 Slim Digital at Rs 64,990 and the Disc model at Rs 69,985 on 28 October. Add the Standard Edition and a new buyer pays about Rs 70,989 on the digital console. Prices move, so check the final checkout figure before buying.
Do not pay extra for the disc drive
There is one trap for new buyers. The boxed version of GTA 6 reportedly contains only a download code, not a game disc. So the Rs 4,995 extra for the disc-drive PS5 buys you nothing for this game at launch. It may still make sense for other games…

Tuesday, November 17th 2026
Intel Publishes Benchmarks for D270 "Crescent Island" GPU, Claims Wins Over RTX PRO 6000
Intel's GPU D270 AI accelerator card, previously known as "Crescent Island," just got some first-party benchmarks. According to Intel, the GPU is up to 5.9 times faster than NVIDIA's RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition in FP64 financial workloads. Going through the individual test results, the D270 system posted a 5.6x lead in European Black-Scholes, 4.6x in Binomial, and 1.92x in American Black-Scholes. Intel also points out the fact that the D270 runs at 350 W, while the NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 has a 600 W power limit. Most of the lead seems to come from the D270's 32 Xe3P cores, each handling 64 FP64 FMA operations at native full rate. These benchmarks were published at SC26 in Chicago.
As for the AI figures, they are a lot more modest. Intel claims up to 29% lower latency on the Drex decision model and 1.12x the output token throughput on Qwen3-30B-A3B in FP8. These tests were both run against a single RTX PRO 6000. In the financial tests previously mentioned, the NVIDIA system had eight RTX PRO 6000 cards running against a single D270, though Intel doesn't mention how many were used per run. Intel also showed FP32 seismic modeling with Veridien, although performance figures were left out for this one. Pour ce genre de requête, Google a décidé de lancer les discussions temporaires dans le Mode IA, la version conversationnelle de son moteur de recherche. La fonction est en cours de déploiement dans le monde entier, sur ordinateur comme sur smartphone, et dans toutes les langues où le Mode IA est disponible, dont le français.
Pour l’utiliser, il suffit de cliquer sur l’icône des discussions temporaires, en haut à droite de l’interface du Mode IA, puis de poser ses questions comme d’habitude. La session est alors « déconnectée de votre compte », explique Google : les réponses ne tiennent pas compte de vos préférences passées, les échanges n’influencent pas votre personnalisation future et ils ne sont pas sauvegardés dans votre historique. La discussion disparaît dès que l’onglet est fermé, et l’on retrouve ensuite son Mode IA habituel, sans avoir à modifier le moindre paramètre.
Temporaire ne veut pas dire totalement privé
Google ne précise pas, en revanche, si ces échanges sont conservés pendant un certain temps sur ses serveurs. La nuance a son importance. Dans l’application Gemini, qui propose une fonction similaire depuis l’an dernier, les discussions temporaires sont gardées « jusqu’à 72 heures » pour formuler les réponses et traiter d’éventuels retours, selon Google, même si elles ne servent ni à personnaliser l’assistant n…

articles.title: Everspin Looks to Broaden MRAM Adoption with LPDDR Standard - EE Times
articles.summary:
Giving magnetoresistive RAM (MRAM) access to the low power DDR (LPDDR) ecosystem requires more than adapting a memory interface; it needs controller developers to have confidence there is enough customer demand to put support into silicon.
Everspin Technologies sees the development of a standard as the pathway forward. That is why Steffen Hellmold, the company’s VP of corporate strategy, is chairing a new JEDEC task group under JEDEC’s JC-42.6 Low Power Memories Subcommittee to explore an LPDDR persistent memory (PMEM) standard, he told EE Times in an interview. “If you want to have something to happen, then you need to be willing to contribute.”
Everspin’s motivation is practical because its experience adapting DDR controllers for MRAM does not translate readily to the newer LPDDR implementations it wants to target, Hellmold said.
The company’s DDR4 MRAM has been implemented in systems such as IBM’s FlashCore Module by tweaking DRAM host controllers to handle smaller page sizes and slightly different timings. Hellmold said that was workable because the controllers were soft IP. In AMD Xilinx FPGAs, for example, the memory interface generator could adapt DDR4 soft IP for MRAM.
Looking toward LPDDR5 and LPDDR6, Hellmold said the available controller implementations instead rely on hard IP, shifting those changes upstream to controller suppliers. “Hard IP means that you need to convince a host controller manufacturer to modify their host controller to also support MRAM,” he sai…

articles.title: Intel Prepares "Razor Lake" in Three Flavors: S, U, and L
articles.summary:
Tuesday, November 17th 2026
Intel Prepares "Razor Lake" in Three Flavors: S, U, and L
Intel appears to have prepared three versions of its next-generation "Razor Lake" platform, designated as S, U, and L, which provides a clearer picture of the company's future lineup, according to the latest set of Linux kernel patches. Additionally, there is a separate "Razor Lake" entry without a suffix, bringing the total to four processor identifiers. Intel engineer Tony Luck submitted the patch on November 13, following the publication of model numbers in Intel's updated instruction set reference. All four client entries belong to CPU Family 18. The desktop models use identifiers 0x06 and 0x0A for "Razor Lake" and "Razor Lake-S," respectively, while the mobile entries assign 0x07 to "Razor Lake-L" and 0x09 to "Razor Lake-U." There is no "Razor Lake-H" definition in this submission. However, these internal labels do not determine the final product range, and Intel has yet to explain what differentiates the underlying configurations.
Compiler work published on the same day provides another detail: GCC initially treats "Razor Lake" as an alias of "Nova Lake." Both targets share the instruction capabilities listed in the patch, including AVX10.2 and APX. This informs developers about which instructions the compiler can generate but reveals little about potential changes to core designs, cache capacity, or performance. An agricultural robot moving through a field must do more than collect information: It must interpret what its sensors detect, decide what to do, and potentially act before it reaches the next plant. Sending data to a remote computer for analysis is not always practical, particularly when connectivity is unreliable or decisions must be made immediately.
Xin “Rex” Sun, director of the Peltier Institute for Advancement in Agricultural Technology at North Dakota State University, is confronting that problem in research on AI-assisted crop monitoring.
His laboratory is developing a field platform equipped with sensors that could diagnose crop problems and eventually support interventions. The research involves powerful computing systems, but Sun wants the resulting applications to run on equipment that farmers can use in their fields.
“Edge AI will be the go-to approach, because if the technology can’t run on a robot, combine, or tractor, it’s of little use to farmers,” Sun said. “Farmers aren’t sitting in laboratories doing research. They need technology that works in the field.”
His team uses Nvidia GPUs for demanding research workloads, alongside smaller computing platforms such as Raspberry Pi and Arduino for other functions. The distinction illustrates a fundamental design choice: Different tasks require different amounts and types of processing.

Les utilisateurs se sont donc retrouvés avec un historique de conversations qui n’était plus catégorisé. Les messages bientôt répartis en deux catégories
Le média américain Android Authority a exploré le code de la dernière version bêta de Google Messages. Il a ainsi trouvé plusieurs indices qui indiquent un nouveau système de catégorisation des messages sur l’application. Les utilisateurs feraient face à deux sections : « Principale » et « Autres ». Vous l’aurez compris, la catégorie « Principale » regroupe les messages personnels, tandis que la section « Autres » rassemble les messages promotionnels, les éventuels spams ou encore les mises à jour. Une nouveauté bienvenue donc, vu que les messages ne sont actuellement pas du tout triés.

articles.title: GPUs alone won't carry enterprise AI pilots into production - SiliconANGLE
articles.summary:
Token sticker shock pushes enterprises from frontier labs toward open-weight AI factories
Enterprises have spent the AI boom racing to secure graphics processing units, or GPUs, but the harder decisions now sit above the hardware. Token bills, data sovereignty and model choice increasingly decide which AI pilots reach production, a shift on display at the SC26 supercomputing conference.
Dell Technologies Inc. has spent the past year pushing its AI Factory beyond servers and storage. Customers now want a full-stack outcome that covers software, open-source tools, models and operations, according to Brad Maltz (pictured), senior director of AI solutions at Dell.
“The hardware’s key because that drives the tokens,” he said. “You really, truly need a full-stack AI factory view above and beyond just the hardware stack.”

Más allá del avance, el dispositivo cuenta con una historia muy particular: fue desarrollado a partir de un proyecto estudiantil del Instituto Tecnológico de Massachusetts (MIT), aplica vibraciones mecánicas en la muñeca para enviar señales al cerebro y reducir los movimientos involuntarios, informó MIT News, el portal de noticias del instituto.
La autorización llegó en febrero, 9 años después de que un hombre con Parkinson de inicio temprano probara un prototipo ante un auditorio lleno en el MIT. Al activar la vibración, pudo dibujar una espiral con una precisión muy superior a la que tenía segundos antes.
En ensayos posteriores, una prueba de uso domiciliario durante 90 días mostró que el 78% de los pacientes informó beneficios. Con base en el conjunto de la evidencia clínica, el dispositivo obtuvo la autorización 510(k) de la FDA, un mecanismo regulatorio que certifica que el aparato es seguro y equivalente en eficacia a otros dispositivos ya aprobados en el mercado.

AMD attacks Nvidia's FP64 emulation at SC26, touts native double-precision on Instinct MI430X — says Ozaki schemes fit less than 10% of HPC workloads and triple memory use and emulated FP64 is a poor fit for many HPC workloads
AMD says Ozaki FP64 emulation is no replacement for the real thing when it's needed.
As Supercomputing 2026 (SC26) opens in Chicago this week, AMD is indirectly needling Nvidia about the lack of native FP64 data type support in its data center GPU products. FP64, or double-precision floating-point math, is widely used in the high-performance scientific computing and simulation fields that are the focus of SC26. For those customers, AMD is trumpeting the value of its latest Instinct MI430X accelerator for customers that still need native FP64, like national laboratories and supercomputing centers.
Over the past few years, Nvidia has reallocated die area on its data center GPUs to favor the lower-precision matrix math that boosts the operations needed for much of modern AI inference. That reallocation only makes business sense, as the total addressable market for AI compute has exploded while the demand for double-precision math in large supercomputing installations has remained flat by comparison.

En Villatresmil, parroquia del concejo asturiano de Tineo, anochece temprano y en plena oscuridad ronda por la zona un nuevo inquilino de más de cien kilos. Según 20minutos, los vecinos aseguran que un oso pardo se pasea por las noches entre las casas y que se lo encuentran a las puertas.
Y quizá el oso Yogui era muy gracioso cuando se embadurnaba en miel robada, o Winnie de Pooh no mataría ni a una mosca, pero este oso que ya se ha colado en varios corrales no está haciendo gracia a nadie. Los incidentes registrados en supermercados europeos durante las últimas semanas, que incluyeron cambios remotos en la temperatura de cámaras frigoríficas, expusieron los riesgos de seguridad que enfrentan los sistemas conectados de las empresas en Centroamérica y el Caribe.

Un técnico detectó la anomalía antes de que se produjeran pérdidas.

Alphabet’s Isomorphic Labs raises $5B to accelerate drug discovery with AI
Isomorphic Labs Ltd. today announced that it has closed a $5 billion investment led by Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital.
The venture capital firms were joined by more than a half-dozen other backers. The group included Isomorphic parent Alphabet Inc., which made a “significant investment.” The search giant provided the capital through its GV and CapitalG startup funds.
Isomorphic offers a software platform called the Isomorphic Labs Drug Design Engine, or IsoDDE for short. It uses artificial intelligence to speed up several of the tasks involved in developing new medicines. The Alphabet unit says that multiple pharmaceutical companies are already using IsoDDE to power drug discovery programs.
Pathogens such as viruses comprise numerous proteins that each power a different biological process. Drugs work by neutralizing a single, particularly important protein without which the pathogen can’t function. Developing a new drug requires researchers to find a vulnerable protein within a pathogen and then develop a compound that can effectively target it.
The first step of the workflow is mapping out the shape of a target protein. Researchers look for so-called binding pockets, recesses on the protein’s surface to which a drug can be attached. The task is highly complicated because proteins don’t have fixed shapes. Their configuration changes when they interact with other molecules or encounter new environmental …

Cette pratique leur permettrait de réduire certains coûts sans toutefois effacer les contraintes imposées par le manque de puissance de calcul.
Les États-Unis limitent l’accès de la Chine à leurs puces les plus avancées, mais les réponses de leurs IA continuent d’alimenter les modèles concurrents. Une enquête de Reuters, fondée sur plus de 300 documents chinois, décrit comment des chercheurs et des entreprises ont industrialisé ce transfert de compétences. Leur méthode, la distillation, permet de réutiliser les productions d’un modèle performant pour en entraîner un autre.
Alors que Washington durcit aussi les règles d’accès à distance aux puces américaines, ce raccourci pourrait devenir encore plus précieux pour les développeurs chinois.
Apprendre des modèles américains sans en reproduire toutes les capacités
La distillation repose sur une relation entre un modèle enseignant et un modèle élève, généralement plus petit. Le premier fournit des réponses, du code ou des démonstrations de résolution de problèmes ; ces productions deviennent des exemples avec lesquels les développeurs entraînent le second. Celui-ci peut ainsi acquérir certaines compétences à un coût inférieur à celui d’un développement entièrement indépendant.

Its developers claim the system has diverted thousands of drones and dozens of missiles, including Russia's Kinzhal hypersonic weapons.

articles.summary:
Los alumnos de Estados Unidos cuyas escuelas obligan a guardar el celular en bolsas con candado durante toda la jornada aprenden entre una y dos semanas más por año, según un estudio del Centro de Investigación de Política Educativa de Harvard publicado el 17 de noviembre. El análisis siguió a 3,3 millones de estudiantes.
La investigación, hecha junto con la organización de evaluación educativa NWEA y la Universidad de Dartmouth, comparó el progreso en matemáticas y lectura de cada alumno antes y después de la prohibición. Usó datos de las evaluaciones de las temporadas escolares 2021-22 a 2025-26, de estudiantes de tercero a décimo grado en 49 estados y el Distrito de Columbia.
Las bolsas son de la empresa Yondr y tienen cierre magnético: el alumno las entrega al llegar y recién las recupera al final del día. Según el estudio, el efecto fue de 0,01 desviaciones estándar por año, una medida estadística equivalente a esas una o dos semanas adicionales de aprendizaje, o a recuperar dos minutos por cada hora de clase.
Un efecto pequeño que no se desvanece
Las ganancias aparecieron en el primer año y siguieron hasta tres años después, según los autores. No variaron de forma significativa entre primaria, secundaria y bachillerato, ni entre escuelas pobres y ricas. Las bolsas también redujeron la proporción de alumnos con caídas fuertes en lectura.

The CMOS image sensor found in almost every smartphone camera was invented at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) in the early 1990s, by a team looking for ways to drastically reduce the size of cameras on spacecraft.
Eric Fossum, the engineer who led that team, later said that cell phones became the "killer application" for his invention and he wasn't exaggerating. Yole Group estimates say the CMOS image sensor market hit $25.3 billion in 2025, with mobile devices accounting for roughly 63% of that revenue.
Shrinking a camera for space
In the early 1990s, then-NASA administrator Daniel Goldin pushed a "faster, better, cheaper" approach to space science missions. Smaller payloads meant smaller rockets, which put the cameras on future spacecraft squarely in the crosshairs.
The problem was the charge-coupled device (CCD), the dominant image sensor of the era. CCD cameras were made of many separate parts and drew a lot of power, according to a 2013 presentation by Fossum. They also didn't play well with other electronics, which made it hard to squeeze a whole camera into a smaller package.

articles.title: Apple en panne : iCloud, App Store et Apple Music touchés par une vaste interruption
articles.summary:
Retaper le mot de passe de votre compte Apple sur votre iPhone ne vous a peut-être servi à rien. Apple affirme que cette panne, ressentie jusqu’en France, vient d’une mise à jour de ses systèmes internes, et non d’une cyberattaque.
Des internautes ont signalé les premiers dysfonctionnements vers 17 h 45, heure de Paris. Apple a d’abord indiqué que tous ses services fonctionnaient, avant de reconnaître sur sa page d’état du système un problème de connexion au compte iCloud pour « tous les utilisateurs », et des pannes sur l’App Store, Apple Music et AppleCare. Puis l’entreprise a ajouté iCloud Mail, le site iCloud.com et plusieurs services destinés aux écoles et aux entreprises. Les signalements recensés par Downdetector portaient aussi sur des difficultés avec Apple Pay et l’assistance d’Apple. Et sans accès à votre compte Apple, vous ne pouvez plus vous connecter non plus aux autres services où vous utilisez cet identifiant, selon TechCrunch.
Les conseillers des Apple Store privés de leurs outils de vente
Apple n’a donné aucun détail sur la mise à jour à l’origine de la panne, mais ses salariés l’ont subie eux aussi. D’après Bloomberg, Apple a dû rétablir à la fois les systèmes de ses employés et vos services. Dans ses boutiques, les clients n’ont pas pu finaliser leurs achats.

articles.summary:
La junta directiva de Nvidia confirmó este martes 17 de noviembre que no pretende restituir a Jensen Huang como director ejecutivo de la compañía, pese a una campaña pública para su regreso tras la dimisión que presentó la semana pasada. La decisión se dio a conocer durante la conferencia telefónica de resultados trimestrales de la empresa, informó Reuters.
El presidente de la junta directiva, Harvey Jones, explicó que Jensen Huang “renunció voluntariamente a sus puestos de presidente, CEO y miembro de la junta” la semana pasada. Según Jones, el órgano directivo aceptó la dimisión por unanimidad y “no pretende restituir a Jensen como CEO”.
Jones expresó su confianza en Colette Kress, jefa financiera de la empresa, quien ocupa de manera interina el cargo de directora ejecutiva. El presidente de la junta describió el episodio como una “transición inesperada” y sostuvo que el órgano directivo actúa en beneficio de Nvidia en este proceso.
La compañía contrató a una firma especializada para “dirigir la búsqueda” de un líder “permanente” que suceda a Huang al frente de la empresa de semiconductores. Jones no detalló un plazo para concluir ese proceso ni adelantó nombres de posibles candidatos.

articles.title: Hijacked Optimizely Scripts Served Card Skimmer and iOS Exploit Kits to CNN, BBC and Zoom Visitors
articles.summary:
An attacker exploited a flaw in Optimizely Web Experimentation to plant malicious code in some of the scripts that customers' websites load from the service, Optimizely said early today.
Visitors to sites run by at least 178 organizations, including CNN, the BBC and Zoom, received the code yesterday, according to Report URI, a firm that monitors the scripts websites run.
The code was built to replace crypto wallet addresses with the attacker's own addresses and to capture card details, but the firm cannot see how many card numbers were exposed to the attacker. The vendor says it has fixed the flaw and removed the code.
On iPhones and iPads, the code was also set up to load a second stage that the firm identifies as an iOS exploit kit, but it reports no iPhones actually being taken over.
In an incident notice posted at 01:02 UTC, Optimizely said the attacker had "exploited a vulnerability in Experimentation" and used it to add malicious JavaScript to some customer projects.
The vendor has also taken steps to secure affected user accounts and added protections to stop unauthorized code from being delivered. The notice does not say how the flaw worked, how many projects were changed, when the fix went in, whether the attacker still has any access, or what customers should do.
Smartsheet's script was cleaned once and then re-infected with a hidden version of the code, which indicates the attacker still had access at that point, according to the firm.

articles.title: Roblox fait l’objet de près de 200 poursuites liées à des accusations d’exploitation sexuelle de mineurs
articles.summary:
Près de 200 familles américaines accusent Roblox d’avoir laissé des adultes se faire passer pour des enfants sur sa plateforme afin d’approcher les leurs. Mais l’entreprise exige de régler ces litiges loin des tribunaux, et deux sénateurs veulent l’en empêcher.
Le républicain Josh Hawley et le démocrate Dick Durbin enquêtent sur Roblox depuis août, et ils avaient invité son patron, David Baszucki, à témoigner mardi devant la sous-commission du Sénat américain chargée de la criminalité et du terrorisme. David Baszucki a décliné. « Il pense peut-être qu’il est silencieux, mais en réalité, il témoigne, et ce à quoi il témoigne, c’est de sa priorité donnée à l’argent plutôt qu’aux personnes », a raillé Josh Hawley, qui préside cette sous-commission.
Avec leur projet de loi, les deux sénateurs veulent permettre aux familles de victimes de poursuivre Roblox en justice, au lieu de passer par l’arbitrage, une procédure privée sans procès public, que Roblox impose dans ses conditions d’utilisation. Et d’après Roblox, plus d’un tiers de ses joueurs quotidiens dont l’âge a été vérifié ont moins de 13 ans, et ont accepté ces conditions en créant leur compte.
Roblox oppose ses conditions d’utilisation aux familles
Devant la justice, Roblox a fait valoir qu’en acceptant ses conditions d’utilisation, ses joueurs renoncent à leur droit de saisir un tribunal. « Il est impossible qu’un enfant de 8 ans puisse lire ces termes et renoncer ensuite à son droit à un procès », s’est indignée la sénat…

articles.title: Apple Tightens macOS App Permissions to Limit Data Access Amid AI Agent Security Risks
articles.summary:
Apple on Monday introduced new controls that allow Mac users to give more granular access to data they give to apps, including those that use artificial intelligence (AI) agents.
The changes, currently previewed in macOS 27.3 beta 2, relate to increased transparency and more options for two of its APIs: Device Control and Data Access, and Full Disk Access.
"Before granting an app such extraordinary access, users should understand that it puts all of the data on their Mac at risk," Apple said in a statement. "These changes are designed to help them do that and to empower them to make informed decisions about their own data and privacy."
To that end, Device Control and Data Access is being split into two settings: System & App Protection Override and Accessibility.
Other changes include -
- A single method for granting permissions by selecting the requesting app from a list
- Encouraging users to grant access to just the specific apps (for System & App Protection Override) or folders (for Full Disk Access) that are required for their workflows
- Increased visibility into the range of data that apps will receive access to or have control over when users grant full permissions
- An option for users to configure apps to ask every time they require access
- A transparency indicator when one app is controlling another app using System & App Protection Override

articles.title: Partidos del Mundial Sub-17 por Pirlo TV: la opción gratuita que pone en peligro a tus dispositivos
articles.summary:
Durante el desarrollo del Mundial Sub-17 de la FIFA Qatar 2026, la búsqueda de transmisiones deportivas gratuitas experimenta un crecimiento masivo. Plataformas de distribución no autorizada como Pirlo TV atraen a millones de espectadores que intentan evadir el pago de licencias oficiales.
Sin embargo, el acceso a estos portales web implica una exposición directa a redes de cibercrimen estructuradas para vulnerar computadoras personales y teléfonos móviles mediante la explotación de navegadores e ingeniería social.
Redirecciones maliciosas y falsos reproductores
Pirlo TV no aloja el contenido audiovisual en sus propios servidores, sino que indexa enlaces de terceros. La monetización de esta infraestructura se basa en redes de publicidad maliciosa (malvertising). Los reproductores de video incrustados en la página están cubiertos por capas invisibles (clickjacking).
Al intentar reproducir el partido, ajustar el volumen o cerrar un anuncio, el usuario activa redirecciones forzadas hacia dominios externos. Estos sitios promueven la descarga de supuestos códecs de video, actualizaciones urgentes del reproductor o perfiles VPN obligatorios. Estos archivos son, en realidad, troyanos diseñados para exfiltrar credenciales del sistema o secuestrar información local.

articles.title: Prise de contrôle de comptes : Surfshark One mise sur une protection tout-en-un
articles.summary:
Messagerie, réseaux sociaux, comptes bancaires… Les pirates disposent de nombreuses techniques pour s’emparer de vos accès. Voici comment leur mettre des bâtons dans les roues !
L’une des menaces les plus sous-estimées, et qui mérite pourtant bien plus d’attention, est « l’Account Takeover ». Derrière cet anglicisme se cache une pratique vicieuse, sur laquelle reposent de nombreuses escroqueries.
Le principe est de prendre le contrôle d’un compte légitime, associé à une véritable identité, à des données personnelles concrètes et, parfois, à des moyens de paiement. Les informations récupérées ouvrent alors de nombreuses portes avec la possibilité d’agir à court, moyen ou long terme (ce qui renforce encore davantage les risques).
Comment les pirates prennent-ils le contrôle de vos comptes ?
Parmi les différentes méthodes utilisées, l’ingénierie sociale occupe une place grandissante. Plutôt que de s’attaquer directement aux systèmes informatiques, les pirates cherchent à manipuler les personnes pour obtenir les informations dont ils ont besoin. Et avec le développement de l’intelligence artificielle, ces tentatives de manipulation deviennent toujours plus crédibles et difficiles à déceler.
L’ingénierie sociale : exploiter la confiance et l’inattention
Les scénarios sont nombreux, souvent bien construits, et surtout en lien avec des situations du quotidien, c’est d’ailleurs ce qui rend ces attaques si redoutables. Il suffit d’un moment d’inattention… On est fatigué, préoccupé, pr…

articles.title: New GitDoor and GraphDoor Backdoors Turn GitHub and SharePoint Into Covert C2 Channels
articles.summary:
Government sectors in Asia and Africa have been targeted by an active cyber intrusion campaign that delivers to previously undocumented backdoors that leverage legitimate services like Microsoft SharePoint and GitHub for command‑and‑control (C2).
The activity has been codenamed Operation ShadowCloud by Kaspersky. The Russian cybersecurity company said it identified the campaign in early 2026.
"The threat actor behind it is abusing the legitimate MeshAgent utility to drop two brand-new backdoors," Kaspersky researchers Saurabh Sharma and Noushin Shabab said in a two-part analysis. "These implants hide their command‑and‑control (C2) traffic behind cloud services Microsoft SharePoint, GitHub, and Ably, allowing the implants to blend in with normal traffic, effectively evading network-based detections."
The modular backdoors, dubbed GraphDoor and GitDoor for their choice of the cloud platform used for C2, enable the download of additional plugins on demand and the execution of shellcode directly in memory to extend their functionality. Traffic between infected systems and the C2 servers is proxied by deploying a modified Erfrp client and Ably messaging service-based plugins.
The starting point of the attack has been traced back to a MeshCentral Agent, a legitimate remote access tool that's used for remote desktop control, command‑line access, and file management. The attack is said to have targeted an unspecified Taiwanese organization.

articles.title: Researchers Detail iPhone Flaw That Let Apps Record Audio Despite Denied Microphone Permission
articles.summary:
A now-patched flaw in Apple's audio service let apps on iPhones and iPads record audio even after the user tapped "Don't Allow" on the microphone prompt.
The first security updates with the fix came out on August 17. Neither Apple nor the two researchers who found the flaw report that it was used in attacks.
Nik Tsytsarkin of Meta Red Team X published the technical details last week. Mustafa Calap, a security engineer who reported the same flaw separately, published his own analysis the same day.
On iPhones, an orange indicator shows when an app is using the microphone. On one of the researchers' earlier test builds, that indicator stayed off while the app recorded.
In Tsytsarkin's tests, the prompt appeared the first time the app opened. Declining it did not stop the recording, and the prompt did not reappear on subsequent launches.
In the earlier build of his technical analysis, the system logs showed no record of the app using the microphone. They named the audio service itself as the recorder.
His demo video shows the indicator while the test app records with no microphone permission. He wrote that the video "was filmed on a later build that appears to have restored the orange microphone indicator."
Calap's test app recorded while its permission still read denied, according to his detailed write-up. No orange indicator appeared in the Dynamic Island or in Control Center. He does not say which of his two test builds that was.
